contradicting_evidence: Negative settled ETF flows, contracting seven-day stablecoin supply and weak current breadth could persist long enough to produce a directional weekly decline.

frozen_forecast.expected_path: Recovery attempts and renewed downside tests both remain credible over the week, without enough evidence to select a reliable terminal direction. A sustained sequence of failed recoveries, worsening ETH-relative performance, persistently weak participation and continued outflows would establish a downward edge.
missing_evidence: A current multi-day sequence demonstrating whether weak breadth and negative flows persist or reverse.
Confirmation that stablecoin supply translates into risk-asset demand, plus broader capitalization coverage beyond the observed proxies.
supporting_evidence: Current short-horizon weakness coexists with positive longer-window returns and modestly positive 30-day stablecoin supply growth; these observations do not establish a common weekly direction.
